hypothesis: If the claim holds, body weight in a growing human will scale with stature at an exponent close to 3.
pass_criterion: Slope of ln(weight) on ln(height) across measured individuals aged 2-19 is between 2.5 and 3.5, with the 95% CI inside that interval.
fail_criterion: Slope < 2.3 or > 3.7, or CI excluding the interval 2.5-3.5.
interpretation: 'Tend to vary as the cubes' is read as a log-log allometric exponent near 3 for weight against linear stature. Deviation from changes in body proportion is permitted ('mainly though not wholly'), hence the tolerance of +/-0.5.

dataset.name: National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) Body Measures (BMX)
dataset.publisher: US CDC National Center for Health Statistics
dataset.why_it_fits: Fields used: BMXWT (measured weight, kg), BMXHT (measured height, cm), age and sex for regression of log weight on log height.
